My dear [Miss Butler](/person/237),
Two lines to say that here I am at home, & shall be delighted to have [Likes & Dislikes](/organisation/248) if they are ready. I go to [Dogd](/place/121) on Monday week, but if I could have them in the interval, I should be glad.

But I am afraid it is of no use to try for two chapters in [one number](/periodical/52) I am engaged to so much, I have been reading Peothès[^1] in English and delighting in him.

In great haste

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: The librarian confirms that the word looks like Peothes, but no explanation can be offered.
